flow: horizontal drag changes XZ while vertical drag changes Y
positionChanged updates the bound Speaker model
visible field samples are recomputed on the next animation frame
invariants: speaker count is unrestricted by architecture
each speaker can be moved independently like a structural node
each speaker can be lifted vertically and its Y position participates in modal coupling
drag end is not a calculation trigger or synchronization barrier
multiple rapid position events collapse into at most one field rebuild per animation frame
reduced preview resolution is allowed only when full resolution is restored after dragging
